expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-cut at the right screen edge ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis or fade, and its card/image is also sliced mid-frame, making it read as broken text rather than scrollable content.

The favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.

The last 'Popular right now' card (−20% pizza) is cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding its name, rating and delivery info; there is no bottom scroll padding so the content appears clipped rather than continuing.

Thumbnail treatment is inconsistent within the same carousel: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey background with a small centered illustration, while the neighbours use full-bleed dark photographic images, so the first looks like a missing-image placeholder.
The metadata row '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' has uneven separator spacing — the first bullet sits with extra leading space and appears vertically misaligned with the text baseline.
The category filter chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no visual cue (fade/arrow) that it scrolls horizontally.
Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '(500+)' review count is light grey on white and likely falls below 4.5:1 contrast; icon-only controls (bell, hearts) have no visible label.
